notes: The list is nearly complete for Sibelius's opus-numbered violin works (Opp. 2, 47, 69, 77–81, 87, 89, 102, 106, 115–117 are covered); the main gaps are the two Op. 69 Serenades as separate entries and the early F-major Sonata. Other early JS-catalogue pieces (Sonata in A minor JS 177, Duo for violin and viola JS 67, Andante grazioso JS 35, Vattendroppar JS 216) and the 1904 original concerto version were omitted because their editions or performing availability are uncertain or restricted.
